name: match_native_functions
description: Match two retained list_procedures inventories by unique exact reported symbols, then unique identical observed function bytes. Optional same-context list_names/procedure_info/read_bytes/analyze_function Evidence supplies symbol origin, exact bodies, bytes and dossier links as supplied static facts. Optional compatible CFG/call/string fingerprints from supplied dossiers propose unresolved groups only. Duplicate candidates remain unresolved groups; only_left/right mean unpaired within supplied observations, never proof of addition/removal. Default summary retains complete Evidence for filtered, selected-column, paged function-matches views. The byte-sources collection identifies selected read_bytes Evidence and its limitations; intersect its IDs with each function's evidence_links to identify its sources. Complete detail returns every group. Existing dossier pairs provide direct retained-reference compare_functions inputs.

parameters.description: Declared Evidence fields accept complete records or {"kind":"retained-evidence","evidence_id":"ev_..."}. For a complete source, use the summary's parent_evidence_id. Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

left.description: Left list_procedures Evidence or exact retained reference

left_observations.description: Optional same-context list_names, procedure_info, read_bytes or analyze_function Evidence
